sources.doc: maker specification sheet PDF (image), via product page https://americanbassusa.com/products/king-subwoofer

drivers.notes: Sheet columns: Re, Fs, Sd, Md, BL, Qms, Qes, Qts, No, SPL, Vas, Cms, Krm, Erm, MMS, MMd, Kxm, Exm, Xmax; Md/Cms/Wright terms not stored. ts_basis not stated; Re 1.6 for Dual 1 and 4 for Dual 2 suggests coils in series (inference). Sheet dimensions A/B/C/D (12: 330/280/288/160 mm; 15: 495/310/350/160 mm) are drawing letters without labels and are not mapped to cutout/depth. KING 18 has its own sheet (see no_ts or separate record). Sd 498 cm2 for a 12 in and 784.2 cm2 for a 15 in as printed.

sources.doc: maker specification sheet PDF (image), via product page https://americanbassusa.com/products/godfather-12-subwoofer

drivers.notes: Sheet gives a row per wiring: params = coils in series (2 ohm); the parallel row (0.5 ohm) is in params_parallel. SD printed as 53.1 'msqM' (10^-3 m2), entered as cm2 x10. Cutout = sheet 'Diameter C' 288 mm (matches the product page cutout); displacement = sheet 'Vd'. Mounting depth not stated as such: sheet Depth G 215 mm and Depth H 246 mm (drawing letters); the product page lists mounting depth 9.29 in for the 12, which equals the motor diameter D 236 mm (possible page error). Xmech 55 mm, air gap height 25 mm. Break-in note on the sheet.
